name: AxisTitle
remarks: Use the AxisTitle property to return an AxisTitle object. The AxisTitle object does not exist and cannot be used unless the HasTitle property for the axis is True.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)

    If .HasChart Then

        With .Chart.Axes(xlValue)

            .HasTitle = True

            With .AxisTitle

                .Caption = "Revenue (millions)"

                .Font.Name = "bookman"

                .Font.Size = 10

                .Characters(10, 8).Font.Italic = True

            End With

        End With

    End If

End With

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the axis title text.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Returns a ChartCharacters object that represents a range of characters within the object text. Use the ChartCharacters object to format characters within a text string.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal alignment for the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of the chart area. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the text orientation. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that determines whether the object has a shadow. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text for the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of row 1 (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart). Read/write Double.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical alignment of the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: IncludeInLayout
properties.description: True if an axis title will occupy the chart layout space when a chart layout is being determined. The default is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the axis title on the chart. Read/write XlChartElementPosition.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlReadingOrder constant that represents the reading order for the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns the height, in points, of the object. Read-only

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the width, in points, of the object. Read-only.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Returns or sets the object's formula in A1-style notation. Read-only.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object by using R1C1-style notation. Read/write.

properties.name: FormulaLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using A1-style references in the language of the user. Read/write.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1Local
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the user. Read/write.
